text: In Seattle, Madison Mitchell has her head [smashed against a wall by her abusive husband|wrong|cruelty at home], dreams that night of a figure entering the house to murder him, and wakes to find his body. Her visions of brutal killings keep coming true while her head wound goes on bleeding, and a voice on the phone names himself Gabriel. Adopted at eight with no memory of her early life, Madison learns that Gabriel was [her childhood imaginary friend|threat|the enemy within], tied to [a patient who could control electricity|rules|it has unnatural powers] in 1993.
